description: C33 — 弃子换节奏的经典示范

intro.popup_en:
Rapid Development, Practice 9
White offers the f-pawn to gain a lead in development.
intro.popup:
快速出子第9局
白方主动弃兵（f4），换取比对方更快的出子速度

outro.popup_en: Summary: sacrificing a pawn for development tempo is an advanced application of rapid development.
outro.popup: 总结：弃兵换节奏是快速出子的高阶应用

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and claims central space.
moves.popup: e4开局

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central advance.
moves.popup: e5对称

moves.popup_en: f4! The King's Gambit offers the f-pawn to gain development time and central influence.
moves.popup:
f4！国王弃兵！
主动献出f4兵
换取快速出子速度
王翼兵占据中心

moves.popup_en: ...exf4 accepts the gambit. Black wins a pawn, but White has the move and can develop rapidly.
moves.popup:
exf4黑方接受弃兵
黑方得兵，白方先手

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops the first minor piece and supports e5. Development begins immediately.
moves.popup:
Nf3！第1个轻子出动
同时保护e5
立即开始发展

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and attacks e4.
moves.popup:
Nf6黑方出动
攻击e4

moves.popup_en: e5! White advances, attacks the knight, and gains space in the center.
moves.popup:
e5推进！
打击黑马，争夺空间
中心控制

moves.popup_en: ...Nh5 sends the knight toward the edge, where it is less active.
moves.popup:
Nh5马被迫边缘化
黑马跑到边线，位置差

moves.popup_en: Bc4! White develops the second minor piece to an active square, targeting f7. The gambit's compensation is already visible.
moves.popup:
Bc4！第2个轻子出动
象到意大利格，瞄准f7
弃兵的收益已经体现：Bc4早早开动！

moves.popup_en: ...d5 counterattacks for space in the center.
moves.popup:
d5黑方反击
争夺空间

moves.popup_en: exd6 captures en passant and simplifies the center.
moves.popup:
exd6过路兵吃
简化中心

moves.popup_en: ...Bxd6 develops Black's first bishop while recapturing.
moves.popup:
Bxd6黑方象出动
黑方第1个象出动

moves.popup_en: d4! White establishes a strong center. Central control and rapid development combine to give White two forms of compensation.
moves.popup:
d4！占中心
白方牢牢控制中心
中心控制+快速出子是双重优势

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king in time.
moves.popup:
O-O！黑方易位
黑方及时易位，王安全

moves.popup_en: O-O! After developing three minor pieces, White castles and brings the king to safety.
moves.popup:
O-O！白方易位
白方3个轻子出动后立即易位

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops Black's knight.
moves.popup: Nc6黑方马出动

moves.popup_en: c3 supports and stabilizes White's center.
moves.popup:
c3支撑
稳固中心

moves.popup_en: ...Bg4 pins White's knight.
moves.popup:
Bg4牵制
黑方牵制白方马

moves.popup_en: Qe1 develops the queen and prepares to relieve the pin with flexibility.
moves.popup:
Qe1后激活
解除牵制，灵活

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 repositions Black's knight.
moves.popup: Nf6黑方马调整

moves.popup_en: Nbd2! White develops the fourth minor piece. All minor pieces are now active.
moves.popup:
Nbd2！第4个轻子出动
白方所有轻子全部出动！

moves.popup_en: ...Nd5 brings Black's knight into the center to seek counterplay.
moves.popup: Nd5黑马跳入

moves.popup_en: Ne4! White's knight attacks. The full sequence is clear: sacrifice a pawn, develop rapidly, complete the setup, and then attack.
moves.popup:
Ne4！白马进攻
弃兵→快速出子→完整阵型→进攻！
这是弃兵换节奏的完整链条
